text.tspan: SpectralFilter (truncated graph basis module) | Operators & tensor flow
N=784 / K=20 / F=2 / V,X,W operands / buffer W / module only / read bottom to top
Blue: batch views and bmm / yellow: Laplacian or elementwise merge / gray: constructor buffers
Three bottom operands are independent values, not a tuple fork from image pixels
V read/projection/reconstruction reuse one buffer identity; dashed shape edges carry B only
Reviewed static source + selected profile. Repeated groups are templates; shapes are not runtime observations.
E### = source span; dashed = side / shape dependencies; fork/join roles are typed in IR; no implicit sum.
Repeated colors encode operation roles. Shared weights and independent instances are recorded in semantic_ir.json.
